_comment: Description transcribed verbatim from EA's Battlefield 6 maps page (https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/features/maps), read from the page's own __NEXT_DATA__ payload on 2026-08-02. Attributed to that page rather than to the game, because it was not read off an in-game screen. Maps carry no stat block or ratings.
_release_note: Announced but not shipped. releases.json lists it under the scheduled Top Gun update (Aug 18, 2026), which the generator ignores, so no Added in can be filled. The Status row below is stated explicitly so an unreleased map cannot be mistaken for a live one.
name: Wake Island

description.text: The legendary island returns. Patrol and defend the shoreline, demolish bridges with C-4, or utilize the offshore aircraft carrier. Maximize every move in this deceptively scenic coastal terrain in the Pacific Ocean.

availability.label: Status
availability.value: Scheduled — Top Gun, Aug 18, 2026. Not yet released.
